name: Kanata
source:
Sonata and Kanata are the two cheetahs that Reika keeps in her room as pets. They look pretty much identical and on the outside they’re cute, but don’t let their cuteness fool you, because whoever they deem as an enemy of theirs or Reika’s will be torn to pieces without mercy. 

Reika is their one and only master. Her anger can cause them distress, and her praise can grant great happiness to them. Reika intends to have them as her bodyguards once they grow up. Sonata is more impulsive, while Kanata is the more sensible of the two.

[From [url=https://daybreaktl.wordpress.com/projectoverview/meet-the-characters/#kaito]Daybreak Translations[/url]]
